description: How your school runs competency-based education: who evaluates, when students assess themselves, how grades are combined into a competency verdict, and how course content is released. Programs point at a framework to become competency-based.

fields.description: Only Active frameworks can be attached to a program.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The scale that defines the proficiency levels and the dimensions (for example knowledge, character, craft) used everywhere in this framework.
fields.label: Grading Scale

fields.description: The earlier framework this one replaces. Keeps past cohorts on the rules they started under.
fields.label: Supersedes

fields.description: Who assesses students, and how each one is found.
fields.label: Evaluators

fields.description: Self-assessment covering the whole program.
fields.label: Student Self-Assessment - Program
When
fields.options:
Start of program
End of program
Start and end of program

fields.description: Self-assessment inside each course. Choose 'End of each competency' only when the course outline maps competencies to chapters.
fields.label: Student Self-Assessment - Course
When
fields.options:
Start of course
End of course
Start and end of course
End of each competency
Start of course and end of each competency

fields.description: Include the student's own rating when calculating the final competency verdict.
fields.label: Self-Assessment Counts Toward the Verdict

fields.description: When a mentor may see what the student wrote about themselves.
fields.label: Mentor Sees Self-Assessment

fields.description: How many grades an activity collects.
fields.label: Activity Grading Mode
fields.options:
One grade per activity
One grade per evaluator
One grade per evaluator per dimension

fields.description: Block sending grades until every required evaluator has graded every activity.
fields.label: Require All Evaluators Before Sending Grades

fields.description: How the separate ratings become one result per competency.
fields.label: Competency Verdict
Verdict Source
fields.options:
Final assessments only
Activity grades only
Both

fields.label: Aggregation Method
fields.options:
Average
Sum
Weighted average
Highest
Lowest
Instructor of record decides

fields.description: Include the student's self-assessment among the values being combined.
fields.label: Include Self-Assessment in the Verdict

fields.description: Framework scale reports on the same levels the scale defines (for example 1 to 4). Summed reports the total of the contributing ratings (for example 1 to 12).
fields.label: Report Basis

fields.description: Highest value a reported result can reach. Calculated from the scale and the contributing evaluators.
fields.label: Reported Maximum

fields.description: How much of a course a student can see before reflecting on what came before.
fields.label: Content Release
Content Release Mode
fields.options:
Per activity (current rules)
Chapter unlocks after previous competency self-assessed
Content open, activities locked until previous competency self-assessed

fields.description: Days a student may leave a self-assessment unsubmitted before their mentors are notified. 0 turns the reminder off.
fields.label: Notify Mentors After (Days)

fields.description: Starting pacing for programs that adopt this framework. Each program can override it.
fields.label: Default Pacing Mode

fields.description: Which existing grouping serves as the program cohort. Student Group keeps it a course grading group; Discipleship Cohort reuses the student's formation group so the same roster is not kept twice.
fields.label: Program Cohort Source

fields.description: Students write a development plan at the end of each course.
fields.label: Require a Development Plan

fields.description: Grades cannot be sent until every student has submitted their development plan.
fields.label: Development Plan Blocks Course Completion

fields.description: Most competency-based programs report levels instead of a grade point average. Leave this off unless your school needs one.
fields.label: Calculate a GPA

name: Competency Framework
